title: Raman active diyne-girder conformationally constrained p53 stapled peptides bind to MDM2 for visualisation without fluorophores
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CB00288A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Danielle C. Morgan, Laura McDougall, Astrid Knuhtsen, Lori Buetow, Craig F. Steven, Oscar A. Shepperson, Danny T. Huang, Alison N. Hulme, Andrew G. Jamieson
This work describes the development of Raman-active diyne-girder stapled peptides that selectively bind MDM2 and enable cellular visualisation without fluorophores, providing a new method for studying protein–protein interactions.
